messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — getting an urgent ticket from ClearBudget: sudden p99 jump from ~80ms to ~900ms for generate calls. Customer geo is US-WEST but traces show egress through eu-central-1 :rotating_light:
Ashok Patel: Can you paste the trace and a request id? Do we have a repro?
Maria Chen: trace_id=trace-0x7f9e
Maria Chen: ```
client -> edge-us-west-2 (10ms)
edge-us-west-2 -> proxy-sfo [via sfo-peering] (120ms)
proxy-sfo -> egress-fra (fra1) (280ms)
egress-fra -> model-eu-central-1 (450ms)
Total: 880ms
request_id: rb_9a3f2
```
Devin Park: Hmm looks like an SFO peering path is pulling traffic into EU. Any recent peering or BGP changes?
SRE-Bot: Deployment 2026-03-16T22:34:10 UTC: network/peering/sfo-update rolled out to 4 nodes. See: https://internal/deploy/9876 (automated note)
Jonah Reyes: Did the client include region_hint or sticky-region? token policy?
Maria Chen: Customer is sending X-Region: us-west-2 and we have sticky-region=on in their account. Header present in the request. But routing sometimes honors it and sometimes we see the EU path. Repro attached:
Maria Chen: ```bash
# reproduce (from our QA box in us-west-2)
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Region: us-west-2" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# result A: 90ms (direct us-west edge)
# result B: 850ms (went via sfo->fra->eu)
```
Ashok Patel: Sounds like routing policy mismatch under partial rollout. Prob a subset of routing proxies picked up the new peering and defaulted to best-egress heuristics ignoring tenant stickiness. Can you run: `rdctl routing dump --node proxy-sfo` and grab config?
Maria Chen: Dumped and snip: ```
proxy-sfo config snippet:
  routing.policy: best_egress
  tenant_overrides: [ ]  # empty for some shards
  applied_rollout: sfo-peering-20260316
```
Devin Park: Aha — tenant overrides unset on some shards. Likely rollout left shard-state inconsistent. Short fix: apply tenant override for ClearBudget to force us-west egress, or rollback sfo-peering on affected nodes. Which is faster?
Ashok Patel: Patch to force region: `rdctl routing set-override --tenant clearbudget --region us-west-2 --until 2026-03-17T02:00:00Z` — that will route them to correct egress while we fix rollout. I'll stand by to run if you want.
Maria Chen: Applying override now.
Maria Chen: override applied, request_id rb_9a3f2 (new run) -> p99 back to 95ms.
Jonah Reyes: Nice. Open an incident ticket and assign to eng-network to investigate why rollout left tenant_overrides empty on some shards. Include the rollout id and node list.
Maria Chen: Filed INC-4721 and tagged eng-network, attached dumps and timeline.
Ashok Patel: We'll follow up with a cleanup plan: 1) audit rollout code path for shard-state sync 2) add a canary test that validates tenant overrides after peering changes 3) backfill missing overrides where detected.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — customer confirmed latency restored. Marking done for support side. :white_check_mark: :tada:
